title: Evaluation of efficiency and acceptance of Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix (Oligo-Peptide 103 technology) application on hypersensitive MIH teeth – a prospective clinical study
summary:
This clinical study investigates the efficacy and acceptance of a Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix Gel using OligoPeptide 103 technology (Curodont™ Repair and Curodont™ Protect, vVardis, Switzerland) for the treatment of hypersensitive MIH teeth in schoolchildren. After initial assessment, the affected MIH teeth are prepared to receive an application of the Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix (Curodont™ Repair, VVARDIS, Switzerland) through cleaning with fluoride-containing tooth cleaning and polishing paste (e.g. Cleanjoy, VOCO GmbH Deutschland) to remove any debris and dental plaque. Afterward, the Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix (Curodont™ Repair, VVARDIS, Switzerland) will
be applied on the hypersensitive MIH teeth on all surfaces based on manufacturer
instruction. Then the patient and the caregiver will be instructed not to split-out
with water for the following 15 minutes for the hypersensitivity reassessment. The level of tooth sensitivity will be assessed again 15 minutes after the treatment via air blast test (Schiff Cold Air Sensitivity Scale), the pain perception will be recorded with WBS (Wong baker scale). The independent observer will assess the cooperation and behaviour of the child throughout the treatment using FBRS (Frankl behavioural rating scale). Whereas the acceptance of the child toward the application will be assessed subjectively through FIS (Facial imaging scale).
After the dental visit, the patient or the caregiver will be given the study material
(Curodont™ Protect, VVARDIS, Switzerland) in a pack of 10 tubes of 3ml which should be enough for a daily home-based application of the gel for a period of 12 weeks. The patient and the caregiver will be instructed to a daily use of the gel after tooth brushing at night before going to sleep. It will be advised not to split out with water to avoid washing out of the gel to let the gel work for the following approx. 5-6 hours. Whereas, disposable cotton buds will be provided to ease the daily application of the Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix gel (Curodont™ Protect, VVARDIS, Switzerland) on the hypersensitive MIH molars. To better ensure that the caregiver will apply the study material (Curodont™ Protect, VVARDIS, Switzerland) daily, a customized made calendar of a three months’ period as well as stickers will be provided, hence in order to reduce (or assess) the risk of the bias.
Finally, the caregiver will be assessing the treatment acceptance, efficacy and their child’s acceptance through the study’s questionnaire.
conditions: Diseases of oral cavity, salivary glands and jaws

interventions.name: In-office application of Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix (Curodont™ Repair, vVardis, Switzerland) combined with daily home use of a Self-Assembling Peptide Matrix  gel (Curodont™ Protect, vVardis, Switzerland) on hypersensitive posterior teeth (SCASS 2 or 3) with MIH TNI-3 & 4a/b/c for 3 months perio

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Hypersensitive MIH tooth (MIH-TNI 3 & 4a/b/c as well as SCASS 2 or 3)
- Children (≥ 6 years) & adolescents without systematic health diseases with agreement to voluntary study participation.
- A signed Informed consent from the caregiver or the patient for the study participation.
- No sealing therapy or in office application of desensitizing agent on the MIH-teeth within 1 month before participation in the study.
- Willing to apply once daily before going to bed a sufficient layer of Curodont Protect (VVARDIS, Switzerland)
- Willing to come back after 12 weeks for Recall and reassessment
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients with acute pain / irreversible pulpitis or symptoms to be treated.
- Patients with systemic disease that require special attention during their dental treatment.
- Parents / children who refused to participate in the study.
- MIH teeth with signs of irreversible pulpitis.
- Allergy against any ingredients of the material (Curodont Repair + Protect, VVARDIS, Switzerland).
